column1: Beat the softened butter with a hand mixer or stand mixer on medium speed for about 2 minutes until creamy.
Add the confectioners' sugar, cocoa, cream or milk, salt, and vanilla. Mix on low for 30 seconds, then beat on high for 1 minute until smooth.

Taste before adjusting. If the cocoa tastes too earthy or bitter, beat in extra confectioners' sugar 1 tbsp at a time, then add cream or milk 1 tsp at a time as needed to keep it spreadable. A little extra vanilla or a small pinch of salt may help balance the flavor; taste after each addition. Do not add more cocoa to thicken a batch that already tastes too earthy. If the cocoa smells stale or tastes unpleasant on its own, use a fresh cocoa powder in a new batch rather than trying to mask it.

Adjust the consistency as needed: beat in extra confectioners' sugar up to 1/4 cup at a time if too thin, or cream or milk up to 1 tbsp at a time if too thick. Spread or pipe onto completely cooled cakes or cupcakes.
